entities.summary: Fernando José Salgueiro Maia, GOTE, GCIH, GCL, commonly known as Salgueiro Maia, was a Portuguese military officer and prominent figure in the Carnation Revolution, which resulted in the fall of the ruling dictatorship in Portugal.
